headline: RXR took a minority stake in Silverstein's 55 Broad Street, a 571-unit office-to-residential conversion valued at about $500 million.
Joyland Management paid $100 million for the Hudson Yards development site at 460 Tenth Avenue, held by Sherwood Equities since the early 1990s.
Trammell Crow bought a West Chelsea garage site on West 18th Street for $67.5 million and plans a 14-story residential tower.
Weil, Gotshal & Manges partners approved a plan of liquidation and the firm has begun winding down.
